summary: OpenText filed an 8-K announcing amendments to its previously announced cash tender offer for a portion of its outstanding 3.875% Senior Notes due 2028. The Aggregate Maximum Tender Amount was cut from $450 million to $300 million principal, and the Withdrawal Deadline, Price Determination Date, and Expiration Date were each pushed to September 30, 2026, with settlement expected October 2, 2026 (T+2). Funding comes from cash on hand plus proceeds of a concurrent senior secured notes offering. Terms otherwise unchanged; no premium or per-note price disclosed in the excerpt, so watch pricing and proration.
